candidates.snippet: Onet reports that a factory producing drones for Ukraine caught fire in Poland. The blaze occurred overnight at the WB Electronics plant in Skarżysko-Kamienna. Surveillance cameras captured a masked man entering the facility premises. The police suspect arson.
